title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Can we give the interest money from saving accounts to poor relatives? 2530 views Q. my sister's husband is tailor by profession having single sewing machine on which he does his tailoring worke and make both the ends meet of his & his family consisting of his wife (my sister)& his four children that is three daughters & one son in the age group of 14 to 4 years,three childrens are school going,my sister is having 3 1/4 tolas of gold & about 250 grm.of silver ,(it is pertinent to enlighten certain past incident)at the time of marriage of my sister, gold jewellery of about six tola was given to her ,but due to financial difficulties she had to sell her ornaments to fulfill the requirment of her joint family ,it is also pertinent to bring to your kind notice that my sister is residing in a house admeasuring about 12x10 sq.ft.with wooden loft which is a tenanted house of mahada belong to her father in law & my sisters father in law's brother is also equally entitle in the said tenanted house & residing with his family & my sisters father in law's four sons are also residing in the same tenanted house,my sister's husband's financial postion is not sound & further he doesn't have his own shelter.in view of the aforesaid facts & circumstances whether i can give my zakat to my sister ,as i thought that my substantial amount of zakat will slightly improve her lot .therefore i request you kindly give me your opinion in respect of my afore said query. 1505 views Q. I have bought a land in the year 2001 for investment purpose. My intention was to sell it and utilize its money for the purpose of building our house whenever we plan to have one since we don?t have our own house yet and are still renting it from outside. Later on, I bought a land and am now building my house on it without selling out the previous land. Now, I have changed my plan to sell that plot and have decided to keep it until, either I decide to sell it or do some sort of business on it. I want to know, (1) Do I have to pay zakat on this land that I bought with the intention to sell and have not sold yet. (2) If so, since when? (3) At what rate per square unit? Kindly advise. 1951 views Q. I found some money (1 note of Bangladeshi 500 Taka, equivalent to US $7) at the Masjid premise (that leads to the entrance/exit of the Masjid and Madrasa), on January 18, 2008. Instantly I enquired to few people like Muazzin, Khadem of Masjid and some labours whether they lost any money. They said 'NO'. I thought it was lost from any worker (Madrasa-construction work was going on ) and hence enquired my best but found no one claiming the money. Then I requested the Muazzin to make a decleration after Isha Farz Salaah among the Musallis regarding the lost money. He did so. But no one came or claimed. Then I asked a local Ulama regarding the matter and he replied, I should wait for 2 months. If in the mean time no one came to claim the money, I should give the money to poor people. 1 (one) month has already passed. I'm confused about what to do with that note. Please provide me answers for the following queries on the basis of the written matter: 1). Should I really wait for another 1 month (total 2 months) to find the owner of the money? 2). What other types of decleration should I make to find the owner? Should I make some posters and paste them on the Masjid building? 3). If I can give the money to the poor right now, waiting no further, Should I give all the money to a single poor man/woman or I can give among 50 people at same or more & less proportionate. 4). If someone asks me for a loan of 500 Taka, Can I give him that note of 500 Taka since it's in my pocket for long 1 month without being used , finding no owner? Inshallah I can give the same amount if the real owner claims the money after I give the money to someone as loan. Please, read carefully and provide all the necessary and possible annwers with available options I have. ZazakAllah 1611 views Q. I am working in the Netherlands and would like to request you to kindly guide me for following question. I along with some of family members would like to start a student welfare fund from Zakat money. Where we are planning to collect our zakat money in a separate account and give to different deserving students (orphans etc.) for higher studies. But this will be a soft loan without any interest, service charges or time limitations. When candidate will start job, he has to return with 10 % of his salary. This returning money will be used for further students. In this case once money is gone from our pocket as for zakat, it will never come back but will be in circle for deserving students. Please let me know the Islamic value of above mentioned process. Is it allowed to do like this or not? Thank you very much in advance for your kind guidance. 1662 views Q. If some one in India does not pay income tax on his taxable income but pay zakat, is he doing a haram/not permitted/sinful act? As we know it is necessary to pay income tax and non payment is a penal offence in India and Islam ask you to follow law of the land. 6675 views Q. Paying zakah while one is under heavy debt 6325 views Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I love you for the sake of Allah (swt). I am salaried class and my questions are related to confusions in zakat and its calculations. Q1) I normally take a cut off date (usually 1st of Ramadhan) and calculate zakaat on my cash balance in my savings a/c?s. It is practically impossible for me to calculate how much of my savings have been with me for more than a year as the balance keeps on fluctuating as per my usage. The balance and savings are not much as I am salaried class but are more than the nisab value. This may lead to zakaat being calculated over the amount which has yet not completed one year in my savings. Is this acceptable? Q2) Due to prevailing recession my salaries are delayed from my employer. Now, I did my calculation of zakaat for this year on 23-08-09. On this day, my salaries for the months of May 2009, June 2009, July2009 were due for payment but not received. I would have probably had it in my savings had I received it on time. Do I have to include these amounts in my zakatable wealth? Q3) Similar to Q2, my bonus money for the year 2007-2008 is due for payment from my employer since 01-01-2009 but I am yet to receive it. Do I have to include this amount in my zakatable wealth? Q4) Similar to Q3, my bonus money for the year 2008-2009 will be due for payment on 01-01-2010 but on 23-09-08 (date on which I calculated this years zakaat) some portion of this amount had become due (about 65%). Do I have to include this amount in my zakatable wealth.? Q5) In my family and cousins there are many people who are financially weak but are reluctant to accept zakaat due to social reasons. Their fathers were wealthy and had fame but they are now poor. So they do not want to accept zakaat as according to them it will spoil their image. If I offer them loan or general help, for example if I give them money and tell them ?return it if you are able to in future? they will accept the money. Can I give them zakaat money and not tell them it is zakaat money?. Is it mandatory to tell them that this is zakaat money that I am giving you. Q6) Can I calculate my zakaat now and payoff partly in Ramadhan and partly in coming 2-3 months.?? Q7) If my zakatable wealth is Rs X and I have a dept of Rs Y, then the 2,5% is to be calculated on Rs X or Rs(X minus Y)?? Please reply as soon as possible. JazakAllah Khaire. 2505 views Q. I have gold from last year Ramadan and I bought more gold 2 months ago. Is it included in zakah with old gold and I saved some cash money as well 3 months ago will this be included as well? 6053 views Q. about zakat 1340 views Q. Assalamaykum. Qureey regarding Fitra of Eid. 1.Fitra is wajib or Sunnah 2.Where i should give fitra.Eg. If I am living outside India, should I give fitra where I am living or I should give in India. 3.To whome I can give this amount.Can I give it to my relatives who are poor , to educational institute , or to any charity society. 7162 views Q. I am a student and I don't earn my money yet. So the money I have is my parents. Can I give charity out of that money? 3131 views Q. I am a employee of a private Firm. I have received back by Provident Fund in April 2009. Kindly let me know that the Zakat will be given on that amount this year. 1460 views Q. Is there a zakat on diamond or other precious stones? 4726 views Q. Zakah On jewellery 2142 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46012 Country: India Title: Zakah Question: My mother has purchased a flat last year around February 2012 and for this whatever me, my two brothers and my dad earned was used in buying flat. We also took a loan from my brother in law around Rs Two lakhs and from my other elder sister Rs 20000/-. In August 2012 in Ramadan I got a new job and Alhamdulillah still working here. I and my dad have now saved say around Rs.1 lakh. I earn around Rs.10,000 approx per month. Now my question is will I have to pay zakah this Ramadan as it is going to be one full year with my job and money. And will I do qurbani this year in 2013. As mother says that we have loan upon us so until we clear the loans we cannot pay zakah nor we can do qurbani. Is it correct? What does Shariah say in this regard? We are not in the position to pay all the loans. We are planning to sell the flat and then pay. So it might take a year or two. So in this case until we clear the loan we will not be able to do these. Please help me and answer as Ramadan is near. Answer ID: 46012 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1031/809/B=1434) Your mother is right. First you should pay your debt, and qurbani and zakah shall be wajib when you pay off your debt. After paying the debt if you have money equal to nisab then zakah and qurbani shall be wajib; otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
